workstream: U21 -- nonlinear PPO baseline (separate learning setup from U20's ARS baseline)
algorithm: PPO (CleanRL-style single-file implementation, ppo_continuous_action.py structure), tanh MLP actor-critic (64,64), state-independent log-std
venv: .venv-rl (Python 3.11, torch 2.14.0+cpu, gymnasium 1.3.0, mujoco 3.13.0) -- separate from the project's main .venv; cara_env.py itself imports neither torch nor gymnasium
reward_version: v3_alive+vel10 (same as U20 run2 -- audited PASS by reward_audit.py, 100.8% margin, before this run started)
pre_run_check: reward_audit.py run and passed before this experiment (see docs/rl_environment_notes.md U20 reward-audit section) -- required before trusting this run's results, per review guidance.

throughput_measurement.full_ppo_end_to_end_8envs: ~730 steps/sec (rollout collection + 10 epochs x 8 minibatches of gradient updates per iteration, batch_size=2048)

fixed_budget_from_throughput: 300,000 env-steps/seed (~410s projected from the 730 steps/sec end-to-end measurement; actual: 375-388s/seed)
task_kept_fixed: same as U20: flat terrain (default MJCF), nominal masses, unchanged action_range_frac=0.30, desired_vx=0.10 m/s. No curriculum, no reward change during this run.

seed0.eval_summary: standing: NOT WALKING (survived 4s, +0.013m). forward-walk: FELL at 0.64s, 2 genuine steps, +0.058m.

seed1.eval_summary: standing: FELL at 1.16s (+0.205m). forward-walk: FELL at 0.64s, 2 genuine steps, +0.148m.

seed2.eval_summary: standing: FELL at 0.70s (+0.198m). forward-walk: FELL at 0.88s, 3 genuine steps, -0.077m. GIF: ppo_seed2_forward_walk.gif (verified frame-by-frame).

comparison_to_u20_ars.both_baselines_fall_rate: 100% across all evaluated episodes except PPO seed0's standing case
comparison_to_u20_ars.note: PPO shows marginally more partial stepping progress (3 vs 2 genuine steps, and larger forward CoM drift before falling in 2 of 3 seeds) but does NOT solve the milestone either. Per the guidance this does not isolate which change (nonlinear policy vs. search method) would help -- it is a different learning setup, not a controlled ablation.

training_curve_pattern: Consistent obstacle across all 3 seeds: fall_rate stayed at 1.0 (never below) and mean episode length never grew past ~20-24 steps of a possible 200-step (4s) episode, for the entire 300k-step budget -- i.e. exploration appears to repeatedly destroy stance before any useful transfer occurs, which is exactly the pattern the review guidance names as the trigger condition for considering a curriculum (starting with an easier/lower-speed command). This is flagged as an observation for the next decision, not acted on unilaterally in this run.
net_assessment: Milestone (repeatable forward stepping) not met by PPO either, within this bounded budget. Reward audit passed beforehand, so the reward is not implicated. The consistent early-fall pattern across all 3 seeds is a real, reproducible signal -- not noise -- and is the strongest candidate next lead (curriculum on command speed, or a larger/longer budget) per the review guidance's own decision rule.
